news.title: The DeepMind trio who built a poker AI are now making money for quant hedge funds
news.snippet: EquiLibre Technologies, a Prague-based AI lab founded by three ex-DeepMind researchers, is now valued at more than $500 million.

news.title: Google introduces a faster, cheaper image generator with Nano Banana 2 Lite
news.snippet: Google is updating its image generator to make it faster and cheaper, making it a more useful tool for creators looking to make AI content.

news.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
news.snippet: Nvidia AI chip competitor Etched says it has already booked $1 billion under contract for the inference systems powered by its chip.

news.snippet: Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5 brings stronger agentic capabilities, lower pricing, and improved safety, positioning the model as a cheaper alternative to Opus, GPT-5.5, and Gemini Pro.

news.snippet: Anthropic's Claude Science is a workbench that gives scientists one environment to do computational research, saving them from the need to bounce between databases, pipelines, and tools.

news.title: X now offers an MCP server to make its platform easier for AI tools to use
news.snippet: X has launched a hosted MCP server, making it easier for developers to connect AI applications with the company’s API.

news.title: Podcasting platform Riverside enters the newsletter publishing game

news.title: The AI jobs debate just got messier
